name: Hot Water Sponge Cake
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ⅜ cup hot water or milk

steps: Beat yolks of eggs until thick and lemon-colored, add one-half the sugar gradually, and continue beating; then add water, remaining sugar, lemon extract, whites of eggs beaten until stiff, and flour mixed and sifted with baking powder and salt.
Bake twenty-five minutes in a moderate oven in a buttered and floured shallow pan.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
